title: Visited head positions bound their magnitude
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic multi-tape Turing machine with Boolean work-tape alphabet and state set $S$, let $w$ be a finite binary choice word, and let $i$ be a work-tape index. If an integer $z$ occurs as the position of head $i$ in a configuration reached from the initial configuration on input $x$ by running under some prefix of $w$, then $|z|$ is strictly less than the number of distinct positions of head $i$ reached by running under prefixes of $w$ (including the empty prefix and all prefixes of length at most $|w|$).
